# Exact JRystal runtime dependency

This is the 66-file, unmodified runtime snapshot used by the paper, not an arbitrary current upstream checkout. Origin: https://github.com/sail-sg/jrystal . License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE and source headers). The package was archived on 2026-09-30; see provenance/baseline_manifest.json for the source Git revision and hashes. Install using `pip install --no-deps -e third_party/jrystal_dependency` after the root requirements. Bundled geometry files support editable installations.
